The structure of Dy3Ge3Pd3 (reduced formula DyGePd) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 9 atoms in the unit cell distributed over 5 independent Wyckoff orbits. Corner-, edge-, and face-sharing relations are observed between Dy and Ge polyhedra, as well as between Ge and Pd polyhedra, though these do not assert an exclusive sharing type for all polyhedra.
